tools.name: deposit_settlement_settle
tools.description: Settles a US residential security deposit after move-out under the state's statute (50 states and DC) and a covered city's ordinance. Inputs: state, deposit_usd, vacated_on; optional city, monthly_rent_usd, move_in_on, deductions (category, amount, item age, whether the tenant caused it), the dates

tools.name: deposit_settlement_rules
tools.description: Looks up the security deposit rules (deposits only) for one US state, with a covered city's deposit ordinance (Chicago, San Francisco, Berkeley, Los Angeles, Seattle, Portland, Minneapolis, Saint Paul). Inputs: state (two-letter code); optional city. Returns the deposit return deadline and what star

tools.name: property_turnover_quick_estimate
tools.description: Estimates what it costs to turn over a US rental unit after move-out; the first tool for a turnover estimate. Inputs: a 5-digit ZIP, bedrooms, bathrooms and the issues in plain English (e.g. "stained carpet in both bedrooms"), which may come from the user's photos; optional unit type, size, year bui

tools.name: property_turnover_scope
tools.description: Turns move-out inspection findings for a US rental unit into a priced make-ready scope. For a first estimate use property_turnover_quick_estimate (plain words). Inputs: property (ZIP, bedrooms, bathrooms, optional details) and findings, each an issue code from property_turnover_issue_codes with room

tools.name: property_turnover_issue_codes
tools.description: The issue-code catalog for rental-unit turnover findings (group.issue codes such as carpet.pet_urine). Inputs, all optional: q (search words or a code), group (e.g. flooring), limit, include_aliases; query and area are older names for q and group. With no arguments it returns every code in short for
